The victim bought 1,000,000 BILL with USDC on the same BILL/USDC pool. In the back leg the actor sold the same BILL amount into that pool and received 4.420501 WETH. So the bracket is a sandwich on pool 0x5b155….

Net WETH: 4.420501 − 4.252186 = 0.168315.

Gas: front 0.007556 + back 0.110264 = 0.11782 ETH.

Net after gas: 0.168315 − 0.11782 = 0.050495 ETH, which is positive.

Residual: the BILL sent equals the BILL received, so no BILL is left. No USDC is left either, since all of it passed through the pools.

Check on the gas figures: 172746 × 43.7 gwei = 0.0075488 ETH, which is close to the stated 0.007556. 129880 × 849 gwei = 0.110268 ETH, which matches the stated figure. The front-leg gas price may be rounded, so I used the stated fees.
